title: Pin actions to a commit, not a tag

job.name: CI job
job.line: runs whatever the tag points to today

tag.name: Tag v44.5.1
tag.line: a movable name, not a fixed commit; moved Mar 14-15, 2025

bad.name: Malicious commit
bad.line: printed CI secrets into the job logs

key.path: the incident's path: the workflow runs whatever the tag points to
key.stopped: never reached once a check refuses
key.acts: a check that refuses the line

printed.text: exit 1  Unpinned GitHub Action detected: a workflow references an action by a tag or branch (owner/repo at a movable ref) rather than a full 40-character commit SHA, ...
$ git commit        # the same file pinned to a full commit SHA

limit: A pin freezes what you pinned. If an update bot bumps it to a bad commit, that commit runs: the advisory tells anyone referencing the malicious commit by its SHA to update.
source: What happened: GitHub advisory GHSA-mrrh-fwg8-r2c3 (CVE-2025-30066); CISA alert of 2025-03-18. Same line, same exit codes: rule pin-github-actions, catalog 1.2.0.
